sql: SELECT T2.CODE FROM all_prevalences T1 JOIN conditions T2 ON T1.ITEM = T2.DESCRIPTION ORDER BY T1.OCCURRENCES DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(T2.ID) FROM patients T1 JOIN encounters T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.first = 'Major' AND T1.last = 'D''Amore'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patients T1 JOIN immunizations T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.first = 'Keven' AND T1.last = 'Kuhn' AND T2.DESCRIPTION = 'DTaP'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.first, T1.last FROM patients T1 JOIN medications T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Clopidogrel 75 MG Oral Tablet' AND strftime('%Y', T2.STOP) - strftime('%Y', T2.START) > 10
SELECT T1."PREVALENCE RATE" FROM all_prevalences T1 JOIN conditions T2 ON lower(T1.ITEM) = lower(T2.DESCRIPTION) WHERE T2.START = '2014-05-09' GROUP BY T2.DESCRIPTION

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.PATIENT), SUM(CASE WHEN T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free' AND T1.ethnicity = 'english' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM patients T1 JOIN immunizations T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.DATE) = '2017'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.birthdate FROM patients T1 JOIN encounters T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Outpatient Encounter'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.last FROM patients T1 JOIN allergies T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Allergy to dairy product'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.first FROM patients T1 JOIN immunizations T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.patient) FROM patients T1 JOIN immunizations T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.gender = 'F' AND T2.DESCRIPTION = 'HPV  quadrivalent'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.patient) FROM patients T1 JOIN medications T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Coronary Heart Disease' AND T2.STOP IS NOT NULL AND T1.deathdate IS NULL
SELECT DISTINCT T2.BILLABLEPERIOD FROM patients T1 JOIN claims T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.last = 'Dickinson'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.first, T1.last FROM patients T1 JOIN conditions T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Otitis media'
SELECT COUNT(T2.PATIENT) FROM patients T1 JOIN careplans T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.first = 'Elly' AND T1.last = 'Koss' AND T2.START BETWEEN '2009-01-11' AND '2010-10-23'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.PATIENT) FROM encounters T1 JOIN immunizations T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Normal pregnancy' AND T1.DATE = T2.DATE

SELECT T2.DESCRIPTION, T3.DESCRIPTION, T4.DESCRIPTION, T5.first, T5.last FROM encounters T1 JOIN careplans T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ENCOUNTER JOIN procedures T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ENCOUNTER JOIN medications T4 ON T1.ID = T4.ENCOUNTER JOIN patients T5 ON T1.PATIENT = T5.patient WHERE T1.ID = '6f2e3935-b203-493e-a9c0-f23e847b9798'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.DATE - T1.birthdate BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN T2.VALUE ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.DATE - T1.birthdate BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN T2.PATIENT ELSE NULL END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.DATE - T1.birthdate BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN T2.VALUE ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.DATE - T1.birthdate BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN T2.PATIENT ELSE NULL END) FROM patients T1 JOIN observations T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Glucose'
SELECT T2.DESCRIPTION FROM patients T1 JOIN conditions T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.prefix = 'Mrs.' AND T1.first = 'Joye' AND T1.last = 'Homenick' AND substr(T2.START, 1, 4) = '2017'

SELECT T2.DATE FROM patients T1 JOIN immunizations T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.prefix = 'Mrs.' AND T1.first = 'Joye' AND T1.last = 'Homenick' AND T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free' ORDER BY T2.DATE DESC LIMIT 1
